name: OCTPUSSY
source:
You are a mercenary. As payment, your employer turns over three captured enemy pilots.
These three girls are the virgins Rei, Asuka and Mari.
Before your eyes their wanton pleasure flowers like wings of an angel.

Good fortune for a soldier of war for hire.
Three beautiful icons of the anime world, three pristine bodies.
Can you train the one you love into your willing partner?

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE086509.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
你是一名佣兵。作为报酬，雇主把三名俘虏的敌军飞行员交给了你。

这三名处女分别是绫波丽、明日香和真希波·玛丽。
放纵的欢愉如天使羽翼般在你眼前绽放。

这是战争佣兵难得的好运。
三位动画世界的标志性美少女，三具纯洁无瑕的身体。
你能否把心仪的那一位调教成自愿侍奉你的伴侣？
